desktop.title: Desktop Dependency
desktop.description: Current IDEs like VS Code, Cursor, and Warp are built for desktop. Mobile still lacks a smooth experience for professional development.

ai.title: Fragmented AI
ai.description: Developers have to use separate tools for GPT-5, Claude 4.5, and Gemini Pro 2.5. There is no native integration in a mobile environment.

productivity.title: Lost Productivity
productivity.description: 68% of developers use smartphones for more than 3 hours a day, but only for minor tasks. There is no serious platform for mobile coding.

emergency.title: Blocking Emergencies
emergency.description: Production down while you're away from home? Urgent debug? You can't always open a laptop. Mobile offers zero professional options.
